title: Drinking water, dry ground

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Hello, we need drinking water for the house.

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: Is anyone hurt, or is water inside the rooms?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: No. Um, the ground is dry. We just ran out of bottles.

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: Which district are you calling from?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: We are in Mae Mo District, Lampang, near the blue temple.

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: How many people, and can you reach the market?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Four of us. The market is open. We only need water.
